name: safe-pptx
description: Safe-DOCX-style MCP server for surgical, format-preserving .pptx editing

scripts.build: npm run build -w @safe-pptx/pptx-core && npm run build -w @safe-pptx/pptx-mcp
scripts.smoke:torture: npm run build && node scripts/make-torture-deck.mjs && node scripts/smoke-torture.mjs
